title: tidb-rs tracker
description: TiDB tests, the Go code they exercise, and tidb-rs progress. Built from data/*.tsv.

tests.description: Go unit tests and integration test files of TiDB at data/source.tsv tidb_commit.

features.description: v0 features: one per Go source file; symbols = functions in it reached by some test.

test_feature.description: Which features a test exercises. weight = the feature's share of the test's specificity mass; links below 0.01 are omitted.

cov_status.description: Outcome of each test's coverage run. failed = run stopped early, mapping incomplete.

scope.description: Packages in scope for a tidb-rs phase (P1 = prototype).

tests_for_feature.title: Tests that exercise a feature
tests_for_feature.sql: SELECT tf.pkg, tf.test, tf.weight, t.path, t.line, t.uses_store FROM test_feature tf JOIN tests t ON t.kind = 'unit' AND t.pkg = tf.pkg AND t.name = tf.test WHERE tf.feature = :feature ORDER BY tf.weight DESC

features_of_test.title: Features a test exercises
features_of_test.sql: SELECT tf.feature, tf.weight, f.funcs FROM test_feature tf JOIN features f ON f.feature = tf.feature WHERE tf.pkg = :pkg AND tf.test = :test ORDER BY tf.weight DESC

incomplete_mappings.title: Tests whose coverage run failed (need failpoints, E3)
incomplete_mappings.sql: SELECT c.pkg, c.test, c.detail, t.uses_fp FROM cov_status c JOIN tests t ON t.kind = 'unit' AND t.pkg = c.pkg AND t.name = c.test WHERE c.status = 'failed' ORDER BY c.pkg, c.test
